scope: Production worker classification of protected Observe renewal responses whose code is neither 2.00-2.30 nor a class 4 or 5 error

standard.name: IETF CoAP
standard.summary: Class 3 response codes are reserved and 2.31 Continue answers only a Block1 request, so neither completes a GET Observe renewal nor carries a remote error status

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defect.observed: A protected renewal answered with 2.31 Continue ended the observation with remote_response and status 95
defect.cause: The worker reported remote_response with the numeric status for every renewal code outside 2.00-2.30, class 3 codes included, while unary and registration responses already reserved remote_response for codes 128-191

assertions: A protected renewal answered with 2.31 Continue emits the terminal error invalid_response without a status
A protected renewal answered with 3.00 emits the terminal error invalid_response without a status
Both terminal envelopes arrive within 3.5 s of the Max-Age-zero report, and the worker exits cleanly
The existing renewal faults still emit remote_response with status 128, invalid_observation_response, representation_changed and timeout
The BEAM wire decoder already admits invalid_response as a terminal subscription error

negative_control.observed: The 2.31 case emitted {"code":"remote_response","status":95} where invalid_response is required

lanes.assertion_output: WCO-N02/N04: production worker completes unary, streamed and Observe exchanges
WCO-N02/N04: production worker completes unary, streamed and Observe exchanges

unaccepted: Renewal codes from an independent upstream OSCORE stack
Unary and registration responses with 2.31 or class 3 codes, which already end with invalid_response and have no protected same-stack case here
